before.exam_tip_html: When writing about school subjects, examiners reward range of language. Do not just list subjects — give opinions, justify them with reasons, and use different opinion phrases (je pense que, je trouve que, à mon avis). Using the superlative (la matière que j’aime le plus / le moins) shows higher-level language. In listening tasks about timetables, listen for time words (à huit heures, le lundi) and opinion adjectives to identify which subject is being discussed.
